Design Framework

A library of web page designs, layouts and voices, written to be consumed by AI coding agents. Pick the ones you want and name them in your prompt.

Pick a design, a layout and a voice. This generates a DESIGN.md — copy it, or save it, into your project's repo root. Agents look for DESIGN.md by default, so this points them at the right combination without you having to name it in every prompt.

DESIGN.md

Designs

What it looks like — colour, type, spacing, and the styling of every component. Each demo is a kitchen sink: the same components, in the same order, so designs can be compared directly.

design

learn

A Duolingo-inspired learning interface: dark navy surfaces, green action buttons, rounded forms, and a friendly rhythm built around momentum and progress.

material-design

Google's Material Design with the classic Material Design 2 blue. Tonal surfaces, elevation with shadow, fully rounded buttons, and Roboto typography. Colorful but systematic.

design

playful

Bright, cheerful, energetic. A vibrant purple and orange palette with generous rounded corners that brings joy to every interaction.

design

slate

A calm, neutral product UI. Cool greys, one blue accent, restrained depth. The design equivalent of getting out of the way.

design

warm-paper

Editorial and reading-first. Warm off-white paper, soft near-black ink, serif for content, sans for UI chrome. One muted oxblood accent. Minimal chrome, generous rhythm, 16px body text.

Layouts

Where everything goes — regions, sizes, scroll behaviour, and responsive rules. Each demo is a wireframe: greyscale, with <placeholder> labels marking what belongs where.

layout

app-shell

Viewport-locked application shell. Fixed sidebar, fixed top bar, one scrolling content pane.

LAYOUT.md · wireframe
layout

centered-doc

Single-column centered document. The page scrolls as a whole; no viewport-locking.

LAYOUT.md · wireframe
layout

document-editor

A centred writing surface with a collapsible document tree on the left and a contextual inspector on the right. The document is the interface.

LAYOUT.md · wireframe
layout

social-feed

Three-column viewport-locked social media layout. Fixed top nav, fixed sidebars, scrolling center feed with constrained max-width content.

LAYOUT.md · wireframe
layout

split-inbox

Three-pane list-detail layout with independent scroll regions. Left folder rail, middle item list, right detail pane. Viewport-locked shell with a navigation-stack transformation on mobile.

Voices

How it speaks — attributes, mechanics, vocabulary, and the actual strings a product says. Each demo is a string sink: the same writing situations, in the same order, in greyscale, so voices can be compared line for line.

voice

plain-spoken

Warm but direct. An expert peer explaining something clearly and then stopping. No jargon, no hype, no hedging — and no coldness either.

VOICE.md · string sink
voice

upbeat

Warm and encouraging. Notices when something goes well, softens it when something doesn't, and assumes the reader might be new here rather than expert at this.
